description: The X-Wall MX+ is a SATA-to-SATA realtime single chip cryptographic module capable of encrypting entire disk (or SSD) with SATA Gen3 (6Gbps)/Gen2 (3 Gbps)/Gen1 (1.5Gbps) performance. It includes RSA2048 Key Generation/Signature/Verification, HASH-DRBG RNG, HMAC, CMAC, SHA256 and AES CBC/XTS/ECB symmetric ciphers.
